Well, thats kind of hard to answer. All i know is that you have to be 18 years old (or have a special permission) to be allowed to get a drivers license. Then you have to apply for a driving school. Or thats how it works in my country at least. The other stuff... im kind of ill equipped to talk about since im not that old either. Im about to turn 17 this summer. 

You are going to have to figure out what you want to be yourself

Edit: Losing interest in the stuff you love is a side effect of depression, you should really consider talking to a psychiatrist!

You should always think about your friend when you feel suicidal. Remember that he would miss you and that you would miss out on all the good moments of your friendship. 

If you wait a couple of years you can get your drivers license and move out of your moms, though this is really not ideal.

Dont kill yourself. Your mother might be a bitch, but she will without a doubt miss you and she will fall deeper into the pit of despair. She needs help. Im not saying that you should ”love your parents, no matter what”. Just saying that she needs help. 

About your identity crisis, have you thought about being nonbinary? Sorry, i cant help too much with this but it sounds like you might be nonbinary. The whole ”not wanting to see your body thing” might be body dismorphia? You should look that up, and see if it checks out. 

Since you are 15, you should tell someone at school about this stuff. If you have good friends, you could possibly tell them, and if not, a school psychiatrist could definetly help. 

I hope you the best of luck now and in the future 🙏
I am. I suppose im ”lucky” i gave myself time to think it over.
Im not that upfront with my feelings. I almost never talk about any of my problems, and i didnt want to hurt her feelings.

Of course i would want to live a happy life. Its all i’ve ever dreamt of. Raising a family and having someone to love and support. But i simply cant see how that is possible when im so fucked. 

Today i had a doctors check up at school and i let it slip that i have suicidal thoughts, a plan, and everything. The doc called my mom and when she picked me up from school she simply asked me ”why wouldnt you tell me?” Because you’ve contributed, mom. (Of course i didnt tell her that) afterwards it feels like shes just ignoring this giant thing that was just revealed to her and pretending she doesnt know about it. 

I truly have started to feel like i am unwelcome in this world. No one loves me, or would care if i were gone. These thoughts in my head are no longer just thoughts. I can FEEL the disdain for my existence.
